protocol.mec: warm process, 1 warmup + 100 timed queries; median/p95 of the in-process query; index mmap'd once outside the timed region
protocol.mec_cli: 50x `mec query ... sc`: process per query, timer covers mmap + query (same boundary as the bitplane CLI)

sum_count.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN l_returnflag='A' THEN 0 WHEN l_returnflag='N' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS g, SUM(l_extendedprice*100) AS s, COUNT(*) AS c FROM lineitem WHERE l_extendedprice*100 BETWEEN 0 AND 2000000   AND l_discount*100 BETWEEN 0 AND 100   AND l_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 50 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
